text:
Asha (CS): FYI - vector ingestion for a segment of private/VPC onboarding jobs failed after last night's replica promotion. Some tenants' onboarding pipelines are stalled. Need embargoed customer note + per-tenant ETA for high-touch list.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-472 created 1: bridge https://bridge.redwood.ai/INC-2026-472. Severity: high.

Marcus (SRE): Quick summary: the replica promotion changed an index shard routing flag, which made the ingest worker drop a subset of batches and mark jobs as 'stalled'. We've rolled the flag back and paused new ingest starts. Requeue underway.

Keiko (Eng): Rollback completed at 02:48 UTC. Requeue started at 02:55 UTC. Most pipelines will auto-recover; ~15% need manual resume due to corrupted checkpoint state. Building a resume script now, ETA ~2h for bulk fixes.

Noor (CS Ops): I've exported a per-tenant snapshot to /shared/cs/vector-ingest-affected.csv with preliminary ETAs. Will append a column for recommended compensation tier per account.

Asha (CS): Draft customer blurb for high-touch: 'We experienced an interruption to vector ingestion for some private/VPC onboarding flows following a replica promotion. Engineering reverted the change and is reprocessing ingestion jobs. Most customers should see recovery within 3 hours. Your CS rep will follow up with a tenant-specific ETA and remediation options.' Recommend we add: opt-in onboarding credit or free week of dedicated capacity.

Priya (SE): Add reassurance: 'No model binaries or raw customer data were deleted or exposed; this is an ingestion state/regeneration issue.' I'll prepare FR/DE translations and short DM variants.

Marcus (SRE): Support snippet uploaded to /shared/cs/templates/vector-ingest-incident.txt. Diagnostic command: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/<tenant>/ingest/status
# returns: {"state":"processing|stalled|failed","last_error":"...","job_id":"..."}```

Keiko (Eng): Confirm no artifacts lost. RCA & timeline to follow once reprocessing finishes.

Noor (CS Ops): Proposed compensation wording: 'Opt-in: 1-week dedicated capacity credit OR one-time $500 onboarding credit for severely impacted accounts.' Jorge (CS Manager) please confirm escalation for renewal-risk.

Asha (CS): Sending priority outreach in ~10m after I attach the CSV + per-tenant ETA. Will paste the Zendesk canned reply here when ready and post list of accounts reached. Thanks everyone :pray:
